FOREACH r1 -> r2
  CALL T1 r2 -> r3
STOP

CALL T6 I0 -> r0
GET r0.F9 -> r1
IF r1 EQ S1
  CALL T5 r0 -> r2
ELSE
  CALL T3 r0 -> r3
STOP

CALL T2 I0 -> r0
FORMAT FILTER r0 F18 EQ S2 AND NOT F5 EQ S1 -> r1
FOREACH r1 -> r2
  CALL T6 r2 -> r3
STOP
